list.name: Changes
list.comment:
fix(footer): remove redundant Terms/Privacy links and adjust layout
- Removed duplicate Terms/Privacy links in the footer to avoid repeated anchor text. - Reordered and refined footer text layout for improved clarity and consistency.

task.summary:
feat: implement ScrollCue, update platform and expertise sections
- Introduced `ScrollCue` in `HeroSection` for improved user experience with scroll guidance. - Reworked the platforms and disciplines layout in `services` for clearer presentation and extended coverage. - Replaced "Tech Stack" section with "Expertise" section, focusing on capabilities instead of specific tools. - Enhanced `HeroTitle` styles for consistent accent alignment and improved visual hierarchy. - Expanded `about` page with SpotlightCards, richer values, and updated team details for better engagement and clarity.

feat: implement `useFinePointer` hook and optimize components
- Added `useFinePointer` hook to detect precise, hovering pointer devices and prevent unnecessary event listeners/animations on touch devices. - Replaced motion-based infinite animations in `MagnetButton` with CSS keyframes to improve main thread performance. - Updated `ThemeToggle` to optimize hydration and client render consistency using `useFinePointer`. - Refined full-bleed rule handling in `Footer` to remove horizontal scrollbar issues. - Replaced mousemove state in `HeroSection` and `SpotlightLogo` with motion values, reducing re-renders and improving performance. - Simplified spotlight glow behavior in `SpotlightCard` with CSS-resolved defaults. - Transitioned `Silk` shader animations to demand-based rendering, removing redundant GPU load for static or reduced motion users.

feat: update BizStock case study and project entry
- Replaced deprecated BizStock images with new assets (e.g., dashboard, POS, stock levels). - Enhanced case study gallery with updated visuals, replacing placeholders. - Updated project details in `projects.json` (refined description, SEO keywords, metrics, tech stack). - Improved case study consistency by aligning text, slug, and metadata with current conventions. - Corrected and extended multilingual and offline highlights in results section.

feat: add themed image support and update components
- Introduced `sync-themed-images.mjs` script to detect and generate paired theme images (`-dark` and `-light`) for consistent user experience. - Added `themed-image.ts` utility to dynamically swap assets based on the current theme. - Updated components (`CaseStudyDetailsPage`, `RichContentRenderer`, `ProjectCard`) to utilize `themedSrc` for automatic theme-specific image handling. - Integrated `useIsLightTheme` hook for theme-aware rendering. - Updated build process to include themed image syncing (`prebuild`, `sync:images`).

fix(footer): remove redundant Terms/Privacy links and adjust layout
- Removed duplicate Terms/Privacy links in the footer to avoid repeated anchor text. - Reordered and refined footer text layout for improved clarity and consistency.
